summary: Bowery Capital is a venture firm with offices in New York and San Francisco that describes a thesis-driven focus on next-generation business software and founders modernizing business through technology. Its Philosophy page says it raises modestly sized funds and specialises in go-to-market and early talent support. The site publishes portfolio announcements such as Enata and insights on vertical AI. Stage, check size, geography, an application route and a street address are not stated on the site.

investmentEvidence.fact: The homepage links a post announcing the firm’s investment in Enata. The round and date are not stated in the listing.
